title: rman configuration
description: Schema for rman's .rmanrc (JSON) and .rmanrc.yml (YAML) config files, and the "rman" key in package.json. See docs/api.md#configuration-rmanrc-rmanrcyml for the full reference.

$schema.description: Path/URL to this schema - not read by rman itself, purely for editor tooling.

packageManager.description: Package manager used by "ci"/"publish". Root-level only - an explicit --package-manager CLI flag wins over this.

logLevel.description: Default verbosity of the classic per-step log for run/build/test/ci/clean. Root-level only. An explicit --log-level CLI flag wins over this.

allowBranch.description: Refuse to run a state-changing command unless the current git branch matches one of these globs. Root-level only. An explicit --allow-branch CLI flag replaces this entirely (never merges).

ignoreBranch.description: Refuse to run a state-changing command if the current git branch matches one of these globs. Root-level only. An explicit --ignore-branch CLI flag replaces this entirely (never merges).

group.description: Release-versioning group for "version"/"publish": true (default) puts the package in the implicit repo-wide group; a string joins exactly the other packages sharing that string; false makes it a solo, fully independent group. Per-package cascaded.

commitMessage.description: Commit message for every group a "version" run commits. "{version}" is substituted when every bumped package in that commit shares one version. Root-level only.

script.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own "version" npm-lifecycle step, when its package.json does not define one itself.

preScript.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own "preversion" step, when its package.json does not define one itself.

postScript.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own "postversion" step, when its package.json does not define one itself.

changelog.description: Options for the "changelog" command/ChangelogService, and for "version --changelog".

ignoreTypes.description: Conventional Commit types (e.g. "chore", "ci") dropped entirely from changelog output, instead of being folded into "Other Changes". Per-package cascaded.

template.description: Path (relative to the repository root) to a changelog template file - not the template text itself. Supports {{package}}/{{version}}/{{date}}/{{commits}} and {{features}}/{{fixes}}/{{other}}. Per-package cascaded.

filePath.description: Where "--write" prepends this package's entry, relative to that package's own directory. Per-package cascaded.

tagPattern.description: Glob for this package's release tags. Include "{name}" for independent per-package tags (e.g. "{name}@*"); omit it for one shared repo-wide tag scheme. Per-package cascaded.

include.description: Extra glob(s) to remove, resolved relative to this package's own directory. Per-package cascaded (a package's own value replaces the root's, it does not merge).

exclude.description: Glob(s) protected from "include" (and from the built-in TypeScript-artifact cleanup), relative to this package's own directory. Per-package cascaded.

skip.description: Opts this package out of "clean" entirely. Per-package cascaded.

publish.description: Options for the "publish" command/PublishService and DockerPublishService. Per-package cascaded.

target.description: Which registries "publish" targets for this package. Default ["npm"]. A package that only ships Docker images (typically also "private": true) sets ["docker"]; one that publishes both sets ["npm", "docker"].

docker.description: Required once "docker" is one of this package's "publish.target"s.

skip.description: Excludes this package from "publish" entirely (npm and docker both), regardless of "target"/"private" - a single, explicit "never published" statement. "changelog" also skips it by default (see its own --include-skipped). Independent of "version", which never consults this.

run.description: Per-script options for "run"/"build"/"test"/RunService, keyed by npm script name (e.g. "build", "lint", "test").

packages.description: Per-package overrides, keyed by the in-repo package's own name.

dependencies.description: Extra in-repo "dependencies" not present in this package's real package.json, purely for rman's own dependency graph (topo-sort, --deps/--dependents, run's task scheduling). An array defaults each entry's range to "*"; an object gives an explicit name -> range map.

image.description: DockerHub image name/repository - bare (e.g. "my-app") to be prefixed with --docker-namespace/DOCKERHUB_NAMESPACE, or already-namespaced (contains a "/") to use verbatim.

dockerfile.description: Relative to the package's own directory.

cwd.description: Build cwd override, relative to the repository root - only needed when the Dockerfile's own COPY/ADD paths expect something other than the package's own directory.

buildContexts.description: Named "docker buildx build --build-context <name>=<path>" entries, keyed by name - each path relative to the package's own directory (or absolute).

buildArgs.description: "docker buildx build --build-arg <name>=<value>" entries - a value of exactly "$NAME" expands to the NAME environment variable at build time.

readme.description: A file (relative to the package's own directory) whose contents become the DockerHub repo's full description, if present.

concurrency.description: Max packages built at once for this script. Default: CPU count.

topo.description: Respect the package dependency graph: a package waits for its dependencies and is skipped if one fails. Set false for independent scripts (lint/test) - alphabetical order, no failure skipping.

bail.description: Stop the whole batch on this package's own failure. Unusual precedence: this package-level value outranks even an explicit CLI --bail/--no-bail flag.

progress.description: Show the live progress panel for this script (auto-disabled off a TTY).

logLevel.description: Verbosity of the classic per-step log for this package/script, when the live panel is off.

changedSince.description: Root-level fallback commit/hash for "--changed-since", used only when the CLI flag is not given.

skip.description: Excludes this package (or the repository root's own pre/post hooks) from running this script entirely.

if.description: Conditional-execution expression: atoms "changed"/"dirty"/"committed" (optionally "= <hash>" or "= {ENV_VAR}"), combined with and/or/not/(...). E.g. "changed", "(changed or dirty) and not committed".

script.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own script, when its package.json does not define one for this script name.

preScript.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own "pre<script>" hook, when its package.json does not define one.

postScript.description: Command(s) to run as this package's own "post<script>" hook, when its package.json does not define one.

override.description: When true, "script"/"preScript"/"postScript" above replace the package's own package.json definition even when it already has one.
